metadata.title: [zh-cn] Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
metadata.description: Advanced Rename and Delete Handler Localization & Tweaks

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether to handle renames and moves at all.
ast.target: 是否处理重命名和移动操作。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When enabled, this plugin updates the links pointing at a renamed or moved file, replacing Obsidian's own link update.
ast.target: 启用后，该插件会更新指向已重命名或移动文件的链接，从而取代 Obsidian 自带的链接更新功能。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When disabled, Obsidian handles renames on its own and nothing below has any effect.
ast.target: 当该功能被关闭后，Obsidian会自动处理重命名操作，下方的一切设置都将无效。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether an attachment that collides with an existing file at the destination replaces it.
ast.target: 与目标位置已有的文件发生冲突的附件，是否会替换该文件。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: ⚠️ This deletes the file already at the destination. When disabled, the moved attachment is renamed instead.
ast.target: ⚠️ 此操作会删除目标位置已存在的文件。若关闭此功能，移动后的附件将仅更名而已。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether deleting a note also deletes the attachments only that note referenced.
ast.target: 删除笔记时，是否仅会同时删除该笔记所引用的附件。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: ⚠️ An attachment still referenced by another note is never deleted, but everything else the note owned is.
ast.target: ⚠️ 被其他笔记引用的附件永远不会被删除，但该笔记所拥有的其他所有内容都会被移除。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether an attachment that survives a deletion, because another note still references it, is moved into that note's attachment folder.
ast.target: 如果一个附件因仍有其他笔记引用它而未被删除，那么该附件会被移动到相应笔记的附件文件夹中。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When disabled, the attachment stays where the deleted note had put it.
ast.target: 禁用此功能后，附件会保留在原先被删除的便签所在的位置。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Which note adopts an attachment several notes reference, highest priority first.
ast.target: 当多个音符引用同一附件时，优先级最高的那个音符会被采用。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Insert each entry on a new line. An entry is an extension such as
ast.target: 将每条记录单独占一行输入。一条记录即为一个扩展项，例如

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: If the setting is empty, or two notes tie, the list settles nothing and the row below decides what happens.
ast.target: 如果该字段为空，或者有两个音符的时值相同，则列表不会显示任何内容，由下方的行来决定后续处理方式。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: What to do when the priority list above settles nothing — it is empty, nothing in it matches, or two notes tie.
ast.target: 当上述优先级列表无法得出任何结果时该怎么办——比如列表为空、没有条目符合条件，或者有两条记录的优先级相同。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Ask shows the notes keeping the attachment alive, says why the list did not decide, and moves the attachment into whichever one you pick.
ast.target: “询问”功能会显示相关备注，保持附件处于有效状态，说明列表为何未作出决定，并将附件移至你所选择的文件夹中。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Leave it in place keeps the attachment, and the folder holding it, exactly where they are.
ast.target: Leave it in place keeps the attachment, and the folder holding it, exactly where they are.

ast.target: Files with these extensions are attachments even though their extension says otherwise.

ast.target: If the setting is empty, the whole vault is handled.

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Not running: these plugins still handle renames and deletes themselves, and two handlers would corrupt links.
ast.target: 未运行：这些插件仍自行处理重命名和删除操作，若引入两个处理程序则会导致链接损坏。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Update them, or disable them, and this plugin starts on its own next time Obsidian opens.
ast.target: 更新它们或将其禁用，这样下次打开 Obsidian 时该插件就会自动启动。

ast.target: 不支持国际化功能，请使用国际化polyfill补丁！

ast.target: 仅支持对 Canvas 文件的画布部分进行修改。

ast.target: 重置为当前值，保持此设置不变。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: Instance method `debug.destroy()` is deprecated and no longer does anything. It will be removed in the next major version of `debug`.
ast.target: 实例方法 `debug.destroy()` 已被标记为过时，不再具有任何功能。它将在 `debug` 的下一个重大版本中被移除。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: accessing an object - but returnObjects options is not enabled!
ast.target: 尝试访问对象，但未启用 returnObjects 选项！

ast.name: warn
ast.source: Seems the loaded translations were in flat JSON format instead of nested. Either set keySeparator: false on init or make sure your translations are published in nested format.
ast.target: 看来这些翻译内容是以扁平的 JSON 格式提供的，而非嵌套格式。您可以在初始化时设置 keySeparator: false，或者确保您的翻译内容以嵌套格式发布。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: This means something IS WRONG in your setup. You access the t function before i18next.init / i18next.loadNamespace / i18next.changeLanguage was done. Wait for the callback or Promise to resolve before accessing it!!!
ast.target: 这说明你的设置存在问题。你在调用 i18next.init、i18next.loadNamespace 或 i18next.changeLanguage 之前就尝试使用了 t 函数。请务必等待回调或 Promise 解析完成后再使用该函数！！！

ast.name: warn
ast.source: nesting options string contains interpolated variables with escapeValue: false — if any of those values are attacker-controlled they can inject additional nesting options (e.g. redirect lng/ns). Sanitise untrusted input before passing it to t(), or keep escapeValue: true.
ast.target: 当 nesting options 字符串中包含使用 escapeValue: false 设置的插值变量时，如果这些变量的值受攻击者控制，他们就可能注入额外的嵌套选项（例如 redirect lng/ns）。在将此类不可信输入传递给 t() 函数之前，请先对其进行净化处理，或者保持 escapeValue: true 的设置。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: No backend was added via i18next.use. Will not load resources.
ast.target: 未通过 i18next.use 添加后端，将不会加载资源。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: init: no languageDetector is used and no lng is defined
ast.target: 初始化：未使用语言检测器，也未定义语言代码。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: init: i18next is already initialized. You should call init just once!
ast.target: init: i18next is already initialized. You should call init just once!

ast.name: warn
ast.source: hasLoadedNamespace: i18n.languages were undefined or empty
ast.target: hasLoadedNamespace: i18n.languages were undefined or empty

ast.name: warn
ast.source: [remark-wiki-link] Warning: please upgrade to remark 13 to use this plugin
ast.target: [remark-wiki-link] Warning: please upgrade to remark 13 to use this plugin
